hero.title: Where people, product and technology meet
hero.subtitle: I've spent 4+ years building and shipping B2B and B2B2C products for enterprise clients. The part I enjoy most is figuring out what actually needs solving, getting the right people talking, and writing the code myself when that's what it takes. I also bring years of sales and teaching, and I've pitched products to investors.
about.title: About me
about.intro: At Hivepower I started as an individual contributor and became frontend lead. In my first six months I built a client's mobile app on my own. Later I built the whitelabel platform that made launching a new client about 5× faster. Before that I was a frontend engineer at ClearMix. Outside of code I've sold dive courses, taught diving in three languages, taught skiing to people of all ages, and pitched to investors. That's a lot of practice explaining things to people who don't care how they work under the hood.
about.work1: I start with the problem. I talk to clients and stakeholders until I understand what they need, then turn it into requirements the team can build from.
about.work2: I keep design, backend, business and clients talking to each other, so problems come up early instead of in review.
about.work3: When something needs building, I build it. I've shipped apps and platforms end to end.
about.work4: I present and train. I've pitched to investors and onboarded clients, and I try to make the technical parts easy to follow.
about.fact1: 4+ years building B2B and B2B2C products for enterprise clients
about.fact2: Went from IC to frontend lead at Hivepower
about.fact4: Also worked in sales and as a dive and ski instructor
about.highlight1.title: Translating needs

experience.title: Work experience
experience.description: Where I've worked and what changed because of it
experience.hive.achievement1: Worked between design, backend and business stakeholders, turning their needs into clear technical requirements. Clearer specs, faster reviews and more async work cut our feature delivery time by about half.
experience.hive.achievement2: Pitched the product to investors and potential clients at industry events.
experience.hive.achievement3: In my first six months, built a client's energy-consumption mobile app on my own, from requirements to production. Users could check their usage by hour, day, week and month.
experience.hive.achievement4: Built the whitelabel platform (React, Ionic/Capacitor, Nx) that took Hivepower from 1 to 5+ enterprise clients. With configurable themes, feature flags and i18n, launching a new client became a configuration job instead of a rebuild, and about 5× faster.
experience.clearmix.achievement1: Led frontend development of ClearMix Logistics (Next.js, Google Maps API), a real-time scheduling and routing tool for logistics teams.
experience.clearmix.achievement2: Co-built ClearMix Intros, a personalized video feature meant to bring in new customers through the product itself.
experience.clearmix.achievement3: Worked with the backend team to integrate REST APIs across the platform.
experience.clearmix.achievement4: Reviewed teammates' code and wrote unit tests for client-facing features.
caseStudies.title: Case studies
caseStudies.description: A closer look at a few technical problems I led, and how they turned out
caseStudies.nx.title: Nx monorepo audit
caseStudies.nx.subtitle: A full review of a large monorepo, plus a plan to clean it up.
caseStudies.nx.problem: 200+ projects, inconsistent patterns and circular dependencies
caseStudies.nx.actions: Audited the architecture, wrote a migration plan and set rules for how the repo should grow
caseStudies.nx.impact: 50% faster builds, a better developer experience, and a structure that works for 20+ developers
caseStudies.charts.title: Stabilizing charts and haptics
caseStudies.charts.subtitle: Fixed the performance problems in our real-time data charts.
caseStudies.charts.problem: The chart library crashed, leaked memory and felt sluggish on mobile
caseStudies.charts.actions: Profiled performance, optimized rendering and added haptic feedback
caseStudies.charts.impact: No more crashes, 60fps on mobile and better user satisfaction scores
caseStudies.modal.contextText: I audited a shared Nx monorepo that held several React web and mobile apps. I was looking for architectural inconsistencies and duplicated code, and I wanted to leave the teams with clear standards for reuse and type safety.
caseStudies.modal.takeawayText: My main lesson: most of the mess came from people working without a shared plan, more than from the code itself. Once the team agreed on a structure and started reviewing each other's work, merge conflicts dropped and everyone could move faster.
